verdict.rationale: ClickUp advertises real-time chat and Brain² 'sees your tasks, docs, and conversations... in real-time,' suggesting some live-update capability, and a community comment confirms real-time chat exists. However there is no explicit documentation or hands-on evidence describing live, no-refresh syncing of task/doc edits across open sessions (e.g., collaborative cursors, instant task field updates), missing for 10: explicit real-time task/doc sync documentation, independent hands-on confirmation of no-refresh updates, evidence of multiplayer editing indicators.
